consequence.statement: Values populated in the runtime config file's `default` block are no longer honoured because the block was removed; defaults must be set in `operational_config`.
consequence.remediation: Move default values into the top-level `operational_config` in the standard Loki config.

original.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.

decision.reason: [ev-0316e25d4611] says the runtime config file's `default` block "was removed" and that defaults should now be set in the top-level `operational_config`. It also limits the impact to operators who run a runtime config file and populated that block. A removed config key whose values no longer apply is a setting-ignored case, and the remediation matches the upstream text. Confidence is low because the evidence doesn't say whether a leftover block is silently ignored or makes Loki reject the config.
